$schema_note: Fill every field per experiment; acceptance_decision is written only after results are reviewed. Keep one file per experiment under data/eval/manifests/.
hypothesis: One sentence: what change is being tested and the expected effect.

candidate_config.diff_summary: one-paragraph description of exactly what differs

datasets.name: flores200-devtest
datasets.note: MUST remain empty until final evaluation; experiments never touch devtest.

predictions_hashes.note: sha256 of every prediction file consumed, recorded by the eval CLI

latency_memory.note: fill only with measured values from the same machine and conditions; never estimate

regressions.description: any metric/category that got worse vs baseline

acceptance_criteria: chrfpp_standard improves or is within noise (+/-1.0) on dev
no new repetition or omission warnings vs baseline
no leakage: all inputs hashed and dev-split-verified
